description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2540013859031 PUMP,WINDOW WASHER: Line 0001 Qty 2399 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0080 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
